estimator: sum_h (N_h/n_h)*k_h / sum_h N_h among available-output strata
construction: For every observed k_h invert both Hypergeom(N_h,K_h,n_h) tails at alpha/(2*family). Sum count endpoints over available strata and divide by their known population size.
coverage_argument: Each integer count interval has noncoverage at most alpha/family. The union bound gives simultaneous coverage at least 1-alpha for all cell counts, hence for both aggregate branch proportions; no independence across outcomes or sources is used by this bound.
source_dependence: Design randomness is selection of fixed windows, not iid outcome generation. Shared source effects can be arbitrary fixed patterns. The secondary multiplier analysis addresses source-dependence sensitivity but has no exact new-source guarantee.
singleton_handling: Use finite-count test inversion, not an estimated within-cell variance; intervals remain wide for n_h=1.
measurement: Condition on recorded adjudicated ratings; measurement error and external validation are not covered.
not_claimed: implementation of a nuisance-parameter optimisation method

references.purpose: Primary teaching derivation of hypergeometric test inversion for SRSWOR
